reason: The budget caps and loop guard speak directly to my biggest fear, so I'd try the free self-hosted version. But I'm not paying $99 a month for a pre-alpha tool built by one developer and letting it run unattended on our agent quota.
objection: Pre-alpha and one developer. If the loop guard has a bug, it burns our quota overnight anyway, and nobody is on the hook for it.
would_change_my_mind: A few weeks on the free version where the budget caps actually hold and the morning PRs get merged without rework. After that I'd pay for the hosted server.
